clues.text: On the night He was betrayed, Jesus prayed this word and asked God to take the cup from Him.
In prayer, Jesus spoke this word and then called God Father in the same breath.
After Jesus called God this, He prayed, "Yet not what I will, but what You will."
Fallen to the ground in Gethsemane, Jesus prayed that the hour might pass, calling God this.
Paul told the Romans that believers received a spirit of adoption, not slavery, and so cry this.
Paul tells the church in Rome that those who are not returned to fear cry out this, then "Father!"
Paul told the Galatians that God sent the Spirit of His Son into their hearts, crying this.
